english.title: Driver of hackney carriage or private hire vehicle fail to return drivers badge
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse, failed to return your driver's badge on demand to **(..SPECIFY THE DISTRICT COUNCIL..), that council having

(A)_[suspended]_
(B)_[revoked]_
(C)_[refused to renew]_

your driver's licence in accordance with section 61 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976
english.legislation: Contrary to section 61(2)(b) of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the driver of a hackney carriage or a private hire vehicle
who had been given a notice under section 61(2)(a) of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976
failed on demand to return to the district council the drivers badge issued to you in accordance with section 54 of the Act

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
